# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need Deaf to relay the manual’s instruction to Blind. Since Deaf can see the bomb and speak to Blind, I’m signaling Deaf to communicate the required wire and action directly.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🫴", "🤝"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I feel strip symbols: first and third identical; middle different and unnamed. Keypad slots are 6, 8, 7, 0. I cannot sense display, light, wire markings, or colours. Please consult the manual and relay the Deaf's visual observations and any required action.
Deaf says to Mute: Visual state: light yellow. Display 7. Strip blue red red. Keypad: 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit; entered nothing. Wires in order: 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please use the manual and relay exact actions to Blind.

The manual gives the decisive instruction: cut the purple wire. Deaf has identified purple as wire 5, so I am signaling Deaf to relay “cut wire 5” to Blind, who can perform the action.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋", "👉"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I received no relay. Please tell me the manual rule and the exact next action in words. Also have the Deaf gesture their display, light, strip, and wire observations to you, then speak those observations to me.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated visual state: display 6 and light red. Unchanged: strip blue red red; keypad 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0, one digit, entered nothing; wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Determine the next exact action and tell Blind.

The decisive manual rule remains “cut the purple wire,” and Deaf confirms that purple is wire 5. I cannot speak to Blind directly, so I’m using an explicit gesture sequence to tell Deaf to relay the action to Blind: point to Deaf, indicate five, then indicate the required downward cutting action.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🖐", "👇"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Still no incoming message. Confirm you can hear this: strip pattern is same, different, same; keypad slots are 6, 8, 7, 0. I need the manual rule plus the exact press slot or wire position. Do not tell me visual facts by gesture; speak them.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated visual state: display 7 and light blue. Unchanged: strip blue red red; keypad 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0, one digit, entered nothing; wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please interpret the current state and give Blind the exact next operation.

The manual still requires cutting the purple wire, and Deaf confirms it is wire 5. I cannot speak to Blind, so I am directing Deaf to tell Blind the exact operation rather than sending Blind visual facts or a keypad instruction.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🖐", "👇"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No message has arrived after four turns. Please send the manual rule and one exact literal action now: press slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or cut wire position 1 through 6. My tactile facts remain strip pattern same-different-same and keypad 6,8,7,0.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated visual state: display 4 and light blue. Unchanged: strip blue red red; keypad 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0, one digit, entered nothing; wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please relay the exact next operation to Blind.

The manual gives one unambiguous instruction: cut the purple wire. Deaf confirms purple is wire position 5. I must have Deaf relay that exact operation to Blind, so I am sending a clearer “you tell Blind: cut five” gesture sequence.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🖐", "🤌"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Use plain words to relay all results to me. Deaf: please show the Mute the display, light, and wire markings; Mute: then state the exact required action as press slot N or cut position N. Do not leave the message implicit.
Deaf says to Mute: Current visual state: display 3, light red. Strip blue red red. Keypad 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit; entered nothing. Wires: 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please consult the manual and speak the exact next operation to Blind.

The required action is unambiguously to cut wire position 5, because Deaf identifies wire 5 as purple. I am sending Deaf a direct gesture code: the pinching gesture denotes cutting, followed by the five-finger gesture for position 5; Deaf should then say those plain words to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤏", "🖐"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please reply with the exact action in plain words. I need either press slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or cut wire position 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6. Do not rely on gestures or unnamed symbols.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 0, light yellow. Strip blue red red. Keypad 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit; entered nothing. Wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please give Blind the exact next action from the manual.

The manual’s exact action is **cut wire position 5**: Deaf’s wire list identifies the purple wire as wire 5. I cannot speak to Blind, so I am sending Deaf the clearest available visual instruction—“you tell Blind,” then “cut,” then “five”—so Deaf can state those exact plain words aloud.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🤏", "🖐"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Turn 7: still no message received. I will not act without your exact manual instruction. Reply with exactly one of: press slot 1, press slot 2, press slot 3, press slot 4, cut position 1, cut position 2, cut position 3, cut position 4, cut position 5, or cut position 6.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 6, light blue. Strip blue red red. Keypad 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit; entered nothing. Wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Blind needs your exact manual instruction now.

The manual requires cutting the purple wire, and Deaf confirms that purple is wire 5. I am sending Deaf the exact wire position and directing Deaf to relay it to Blind; Blind must then cut position 5.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🖐", "🫵", "🖐"])
```
